chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
Loving one another is half of wisdom.
ai.seo_question: What does Imam Ali mean when he says loving one another is half of wisdom?
ai.summary: In this concise maxim from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) identifies al-tawaddud (mutual affection and approachability) as half of al-'aql (wisdom), highlighting that intellectual acuity is incomplete without social warmth. Shia scholars interpret this to mean that true wisdom requires both the cognitive ability to discern truth and the emotional intelligence to foster unity, reflecting the Prophetic tradition that 'love spreads goodness.' This pairing underscores the Shia emphasis on the integration of intellect (aql) and heart (qalb) in achieving spiritual and social perfection.

en.sayed-ali-raza: 142. Amīr al-mu’minīn, peace be upon him, said:
Loving one another is half of wisdom
